title: Starlight Run
lyrics:
[00:00.00] Engines hum beneath the neon glow
[00:07.00] We chase the skyline where the cold winds blow
[00:14.00] Keep your heart in time, keep your eyes ahead
[00:21.00] We are lightning in a thread

title: Anchor in the Storm
lyrics:
[00:00.00] Waves keep calling but we will not break
[00:06.00] Hold the chorus steady for each other
[00:13.00] Through the thunder we will find the way
[00:20.00] You are my anchor in the storm

title: City Choir
lyrics:
[00:00.00] Every streetlight sings in harmony
[00:05.00] Footsteps turn to drums under our feet
[00:11.00] Raise your voice above the traffic noise
[00:18.00] This city is our choir
